newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: APC Group acquires 40 pct of telecom firm.
newsitem.headline: APC Group acquires 40 pct of telecom firm.

text.p: Holding firm APC Group Inc said on Wednesday its board of directors had approved the acquisition of 40 percent of Philippine Global Communications Inc (Philcom).
In a statement, APC said it also has an option to acquire an additional 22 percent stake in Philcom, an international gateway facility (IGF) operator.
The statement did not state the acquisition cost. Officials from Philcom and APC were unavailable for comment.
Seven representatives of the APC Group were elected today as part of the 13-man member Philcom board, the statement added.
As an IGF operator, Philcom is required under Philippine law to install 300,000 telephone lines in three years or by 1998.
